name: claude-quick-ai
title: Claude Quick AI
description: Ask Claude from the root search, with streaming answers, follow-ups and chat history. Works through the Anthropic API or the Claude Code CLI (subscription).
author: zxsleebu

commands.name: ask-claude
commands.title: Ask Claude
commands.subtitle: Claude
commands.description: Ask Claude a question and get a streaming answer. Can be used as a fallback command.

commands.name: chat-history
commands.title: Claude Chat History
commands.subtitle: Claude
commands.description: Browse, continue and delete previous conversations with Claude.

preferences.name: backend
preferences.title: Backend
preferences.description: Where requests go: the Anthropic Messages API, or the local Claude Code CLI (uses your Claude subscription, no API key needed).

preferences.name: customModel
preferences.title: Custom Model
preferences.description: Optional model id that overrides the dropdown (e.g. a model name exposed by your proxy).

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Anthropic API key (API backend only). Leave empty for a local proxy that needs no auth.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Base URL
preferences.description: API backend only. Change it to point at a local proxy such as CLIProxyAPI (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8317).

preferences.name: maxTokens
preferences.title: Max Tokens
preferences.description: API backend only: max_tokens for each answer.

preferences.name: claudePath
preferences.title: Claude Binary
preferences.description: CLI backend only: path to the claude binary. Empty means search PATH and ~/.local/bin.

preferences.name: clearArgument
preferences.title: Clear Question Field
preferences.label: Clear the launcher question field after asking
preferences.description: Vicinae keeps text typed into the question field and shows it again next time. When on, the extension briefly resets the launcher (the window blinks) so the field starts empty.
